sign_and_basis.opening_sign_definition: sigma_i=sign(partial g_i / partial q_P_i) from a centered native-metre directional derivative at the hash-bound B4E rk4_reference acquisition

command_profile.profile: Q_P_i(t)=alpha_i sigma_i Q_ref sin(pi (t-t_start)/T_cmd)^2 for t_start<=t<=t_start+T_cmd; otherwise zero

synthetic_geometry_validity_domain.evaluation: every accepted integrator stage, stored sample and exact event state

actuator_work_ledger.primary_integration: augment active state with W_act_dot=P_act and integrate with the same accepted integrator stages
actuator_work_ledger.independent_audit: composite quadrature from raw Q_P and qdot_P samples with step refinement
actuator_work_ledger.linear_momentum_identity: P_service+P_target = constant because the declared joint actuation is internal
actuator_work_ledger.angular_momentum_identity: H_service+H_target_about_fixed_inertial_origin = constant because the declared joint actuation is internal

removal_transition.eligibility: inherit B4E continuous bilateral clearance, gap-rate, dwell and active-ledger checks plus command_exact_zero
removal_transition.state_at_removal: exact event-time reconstruction; nearest-sample rounding forbidden
removal_transition.mapping: z_before=L(q_r)eta_r; z_after is a componentwise copy
removal_transition.post_release_model: independent 29D service plus 13D target zero-external free flight
